notes: The manual's hardware list says 100 ohm resistor, but the schematic labels it 10K; the text and parts list (100 ohm) are used.
The speaker is not in the catalogue (only a piezo buzzer), so a new 'speaker' type was added. Port 1 is the lead to the breadboard (red), port 2 is the lead to GND (black).
The speaker's black lead goes directly into the Uno GND socket beside AREF (named GND.3 here). The power-header GND (GND.1) feeds the 4.7k resistor's ground.

Breadboard hole positions are read from the circuit image: speaker lead at 9t.g, 100 ohm resistor bridging 9t.f to 9b.e, pin 9 wire at 9b.d, photoresistor bridging 21t.f to 21b.e, 5V at 21t.h, A0 at 21b.d, 4.7k resistor from 21b.c to 24b.c, GND wire at 24b.b.
Resistor values are given as ohms (100 and 4700).
